def decimal_To_Binary(N):
    """Write a python function to convert a decimal number to binary number."""
    if N == 0:
        return 0
    sign = -1 if N < 0 else 1
    n = abs(N)
    binary = 0
    place = 1
    while n > 0:
        binary += (n % 2) * place
        place *= 10
        n //= 2
    return sign * binary
